author: CNET
description:
We got a sneak peek at the newest Gemini Intelligence features coming to Google's Pixel 11 series of phones. CNET Senior Reporter Abrar Al-Heeti gives us a demo of two: Live Translation for Media, which makes it easier to watch videos in your own language, and Magic Capture which helps you take great pictures without having to worry about framing the perfect shot.
